analysis: The PR adds only a test file, provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomFanHelperTests/FanStartupDiscoveryTests.swift (399 lines). It contains no production code and no change to the network, auth, attestation, encryption, billing or data-exposure surface. The tests describe fan-helper discovery/recovery behavior (TB-010, T-044..T-048, A-014). They assert: lazy rediscovery with a 30s retry deadline; the journal is written before the first manual SMC write; recovery revokes old leases and requires a fresh renewal; failed Auto restoration keeps the journal and blocks discovery; sleep/wake, disable and shutdown fence a suspended recovery; foreign ownership of F0Md/Ftst is refused; the macOS thermal override is preserved; the RPM floor is kept. These are positive coverage for fan-safety threats such as T-046 and T-047. The production code that implements this behavior (FanDaemon recovery logic) is not in the supplied units, so I could not verify it; the next pass should check the actual helper changes if they are in the PR. Minor note: line 61 prints encoded status JSON to test output, which contains only synthetic harness data and is not a security issue. No findings.
